pretreatment: IMEC clean 20,21 to create a hydrophilic SiO2 surface with a nominal thickness of 11 nm
evidence: The ALD of HfO2 was performed on 300 mm p-type Si substrates with a (100) crystallographic orientation. Before the ALD, all substrates received an IMEC clean 20,21 to create a hydrophilic SiO2 surface with a nominal thickness of 11 nm.
